### Fixed

- (gs) [Keep semverFilter and custom range on edit on the 0.244 line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2830) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — With the edit template from backstage-catalogs v0.7.2, `Edit` on a deployment's page keeps an existing `semverFilter` and pre-fills a range such as `>=1.0.0 <3.0.0` as a custom range. The About card's `Auto-upgrade` reads ranges the way Flux does.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v0.246.4...v0.246.5
